title: Test the frozen five-gene score in paired organs from laparoscopically negative Finnish controls
question: Is the peritoneum-minus-uterus signed five-gene score positive within same-run, verified WG-6 paired tissues from surgically negative donors?
scope: Execute the protocol frozen at d4c6ba1 in PR #51. Only the specified native control pairs, public Figshare v1 archive prefix and pinned manufacturer manifests. No other expression analyses, no gene discovery, no paid compute, restricted sources or external contact.
steps: Reuse pinned private inputs, reserve the task and lock native metadata selection and chip eligibility before decoding target expression.
Stop without opening target signals if fewer than six pairs pass. Otherwise run the frozen score and exact inference with synthetic controls, independent ranks and descriptive sensitivity.
Verify and publish only aggregates, code, tests, source provenance and limitations in a separate PR.
deliverables: Reproducible chip attrition and exact inference where estimable, or documented stop condition
Source-linked results note, tests and reviewable follow-up PR
acceptance: Respect one common run and one physical specimen per tissue, one contribution per donor, full 48,701-address exclusive WG-6 identity, all five locked addresses/directions and the six-pair gate.

If qualified, report mean in percentile points, positive/zero/negative counts, exact two-sided sign-flip and common-shift interval, phase sensitivity, repeat and leave-one-out checks. Report any failures without switching methods.
No individual clinical or expression records in tracked files, issue text or logs. Report provenance, executed tests, data limitations and implications for the full specificity question.
